decision: Create a dedicated English investor funnel for people buying property in Israel, not a machine translation of Hebrew pages.
implementation_spec: Write persona-specific English pages under /en with their own questions, trust blocks, sources, and concierge CTA.
why_this_way: Foreign buyers need remote-process, tax, mortgage, language, and trust answers before they click a project.
acceptance_gate: First /en page screenshot shows foreign-buyer copy, source dates, legal caveat, and project paths.

decision: Use separate URLs for English pages and reciprocal language annotations when matching Hebrew versions exist.
implementation_spec: Keep /en as the English hub and use matching canonical/hreflang decisions per route.
why_this_way: Google recommends different URLs for language versions and hreflang when alternates exist.
acceptance_gate: Each indexable English route has canonical and language alternate decisions in the page map.

implementation_spec: Start with pages that connect project monetization, city demand, due diligence, and concierge leads.
why_this_way: This gives contractors an investor-facing asset without pretending the full English universe is done.
acceptance_gate: All six first pages have owner-approved screenshots, no legal overclaims, and source notes.

decision: Every premium project page needs an English project path and showroom path only after source and asset gates are passed.
implementation_spec: Project pages must show asset truth, price bands if approved, unit interest, map/view context, and concierge CTA.
why_this_way: Foreign buyers are a high-value audience for 3D showrooms, but fake assets destroy trust.
acceptance_gate: Project screenshot shows official/real/missing asset state and no fake tour claims.

decision: Tax pages must link to official Tax Authority sources and carry legal review status.
implementation_spec: Use official purchase tax pages and official calculator links. Do not publish brackets without date/source and review.
why_this_way: Tax guidance is high risk and changes over time.
acceptance_gate: Tax page cannot be indexed until source date and reviewer status are visible internally.
evidence_or_source: Israel Tax Authority real estate tax: https://www.gov.il/en/departments/topics/realty_taxation; simulator: https://www.gov.il/en/service/real_eatate_taxsimulator

decision: Mortgage pages must be reviewed by a qualified advisor and source macro/rate context from official banking sources where relevant.
implementation_spec: Explain process and questions; do not promise approval, LTV, rates, or timelines.
why_this_way: Foreign buyer mortgage questions are conversion drivers and legal/finance risk.
acceptance_gate: Mortgage guide screenshot shows caveat, advisor CTA, and no rate promise.

decision: Create one foreign-buyer concierge flow with country, language, budget band, project interest, timeline, intent, and preferred contact channel.
implementation_spec: Use bands and categories. Store contact in CRM/form system, not analytics.
why_this_way: Concierge is the bridge from SEO traffic to monetization and human handling.
acceptance_gate: Lead payload includes route, language, country, budget band, project id if present, and consent status.

decision: Create English trust pages for safe buying, fake listings, professional verification, and remote purchase checks.
implementation_spec: Link from every English money page to trust content and verified professional routes.
why_this_way: Cold international visitors need proof before engaging.
acceptance_gate: Trust page screenshot includes checklist, source notes, and clear professional routing.

decision: English professional categories must show language, verification method, disclosure, city, and inquiry route.
implementation_spec: Start with lawyers, mortgage advisors, property management, and realtors.
why_this_way: Professionals are part of the foreign-buyer funnel and a revenue layer.
acceptance_gate: No profile appears as verified without verification record.

decision: Show prices and areas in buyer-friendly formats only when source data is approved.
implementation_spec: Use shekel as source currency, optional approximate USD/EUR display with rate source and timestamp later.
why_this_way: Foreign buyers compare across currencies, but stale conversion rates create liability.
acceptance_gate: No currency conversion appears without source and timestamp.
evidence_or_source: Bank of Israel representative rates page via https://www.boi.org.il/en/

decision: Every English page gets canonical owner, source date, legal gate, reviewer, and internal-link targets in the registry.
implementation_spec: Do not let English pages become duplicate Hebrew translations or unsupported SEO fragments.
why_this_way: This prevents international content from cannibalizing Hebrew money pages or spreading thin pages.
acceptance_gate: Registry row exists before writing starts.

decision: Keep FR/RU/AR as future reviewed language tracks, not automatic mirrors.
implementation_spec: Build EN first. Add other languages only when source review, native copy, and route ownership exist.
why_this_way: Bad translations reduce trust and can create legal problems.
acceptance_gate: No future-language route is indexable without owner-approved content and review.

decision: Create a separate Israelis-investing-abroad track for Cyprus, Greece, Dubai, and Thailand, but keep it noindex until official country source packs exist.
implementation_spec: Use /abroad/{country} for Hebrew Israeli-investor pages. Do not mix them into the /en Israel buyer funnel.
why_this_way: This lets NadLan expand without signalling that the whole site is a non-Israel brokerage.
acceptance_gate: Country page remains noindex until local legal/tax/source/asset gates pass.

decision: Limit internal links to abroad pages until Israeli authority is stable.
implementation_spec: Link abroad only from investment and tool contexts, not from every main navigation surface at launch.
why_this_way: The site must remain centered on Israeli real estate while testing abroad demand.
acceptance_gate: Internal-link audit shows abroad pages are a small controlled cluster.

decision: Measure language switch, English page route, project interest, tax/mortgage guide engagement, concierge start, and concierge submit.
implementation_spec: Use the analytics dictionary events language_switch, intl route engagement, and generate_lead with lead_type=foreign_buyer.
why_this_way: The funnel must prove value to contractors and advisors.
acceptance_gate: Debug screenshots exist for English route and concierge submit before dashboard claims.

decision: Every international page build needs desktop and 390px screenshots plus visible text review.
implementation_spec: Check language, legal caveat, source links, form states, no horizontal overflow, and no fake assets.
why_this_way: The user requires visual proof and readable owner artifacts.
acceptance_gate: Screenshots are saved and linked from evidence register.
